steamify.options.title: Controller Settings
steamify.haptic.mining.tooltip: A faint tick at each crack stage while breaking a block
steamify.haptic.fishing.tooltip: A buzz the moment a fish takes the bait
steamify.haptic.explosion.tooltip: Rumble from nearby explosions, stronger the closer they are
steamify.haptic.thunder.tooltip: Rumble when lightning strikes, stronger the closer it is
steamify.haptic.bow.tooltip: Ticks that quicken as a bow draws and a click at full draw. Also clicks when a crossbow loads or a trident is ready
steamify.haptic.shield.tooltip: A thud when your shield stops a hit
steamify.haptic.heartbeat.tooltip: A heartbeat at 3 hearts and below, faster the lower you go
steamify.haptic.trigger.tooltip: Pulling a trigger past its click point
steamify.haptic.rightPad.tooltip: Light ticks while your thumb moves on the right trackpad
steamify.haptic.hotbar.tooltip: A tick each time the left trackpad picks a new hotbar slot
steamify.haptic.footsteps.tooltip: Each step on the ground, alternating left and right
steamify.haptic.damage.tooltip: Taking damage, harder the bigger the hit
steamify.haptic.landing.tooltip: Hitting the ground after a fall, stronger the further you fell
steamify.haptic.flight.tooltip: Low wind rumble while gliding or flying, pulsing faster the faster you go
steamify.haptic.falling.tooltip: Sharp rattle while falling, faster the faster you fall
steamify.calibrate.title: Calibrate Gyro
steamify.calibrate.hint: Put the controller down on a flat surface and don't touch it
steamify.calibrate.waiting: Waiting for the controller to be still...
steamify.calibrate.noGyro: No controller with a gyro connected
steamify.calibrate.button.tooltip: Measures the gyro's resting drift with the controller lying still. Redo it if aiming drifts or slow turns feel off
steamify.calibrate.prompt.title: Calibrate your gyro?
steamify.calibrate.prompt: Gyro aiming feels best once the controller has been calibrated. It takes a few seconds with the controller lying on a flat surface.
steamify.options.sets.tooltip: Extra layers of controller binds, switched on by a button, a grip or a stick touch
steamify.sets.title: Action Sets
steamify.sets.add.tooltip: A layer of binds on top of the normal ones. It only changes the binds you set in it
steamify.sets.name: Name
steamify.sets.trigger.tooltip: Click, then press the button or combo, or touch a grip or stick. Already holding a grip? Let go and touch it again. Hold B for a second to cancel
steamify.sets.mode.tooltip: Hold: on while the trigger is held. Toggle: each press switches it. While Released: on while the trigger is NOT touched, e.g. letting go of a grip
steamify.sets.gyro.tooltip: Gyro while this set is on. Unchanged leaves it to the sets below, normally on while the right pad is touched
steamify.battery.low.title: Controller battery low
steamify.sets.items.tooltip: Click while holding an item to add it, again to remove it. With an empty hand: clear. With items set, the set is only on while you hold one of them (and its button trigger, if it has one, is active)
steamify.sets.tunes.tooltip: Stick, pad and gyro speed, deadzone, Steady Aim and aim assist while this set is on
steamify.sets.tunes.title: %s: Sensitivity
steamify.sets.tunes.slider.tooltip: All the way left: unchanged, the normal Controller Settings value applies
steamify.sets.binds.tooltip: Controls screen for this set. Grey binds come from the normal layout. Esc unbinds in this set, Backspace goes back to the normal bind
steamify.sets.editing: Editing action set: %s  (Esc unbinds, Backspace uses the normal bind)
steamify.option.hotbar.strip.tooltip: OFF: a 3x3 grid in the middle of the screen, slots 1-3 on the top row. ON: the pad's width maps to the hotbar, left edge slot 1, right edge slot 9
steamify.option.hotbar.gridSpot.tooltip: Center: the grid pops up while the left pad is touched. A corner: the grid stays there in place of the normal hotbar. Not used with Strip Layout
steamify.debug.title: Debug Shortcuts
steamify.option.look.stickSpeed.tooltip: How fast the right stick turns the camera
steamify.option.look.padSpeed.tooltip: How far the camera turns per swipe on the right trackpad
steamify.option.look.gyro.tooltip: Camera rotation per controller rotation. 1.0x turns the camera exactly as far as you turn the controller
steamify.option.look.stickDeadzone.toolt: How far a stick must move before it counts. Raise it if the camera or player drifts on its own
steamify.option.menu.cursorSpeed.tooltip: How fast the right stick and trackpad move the cursor in menus
steamify.option.look.invertY.tooltip: Flips up and down for stick, trackpad and gyro camera control
steamify.option.gyro.steadyAim.tooltip: Lowers gyro sensitivity while drawing a bow, charging a crossbow, readying a trident, using a spyglass or holding a loaded crossbow
How much Steady Aim lowers gyro sensitivity
steamify.option.aim.assist.tooltip: Slows turning while your crosshair is on a mob in reach and gently pulls toward it while you steer. Controller only, never affects the mouse
steamify.option.aim.assistStrength.toolt: How strongly aim assist slows and pulls
steamify.option.aim.assistSingleplayerOn: Turns aim assist off on servers and LAN worlds
steamify.onboard.title: Steamify Setup
steamify.onboard.page1: This can be changed later in settings
steamify.onboard.page2: Gyro aiming feels best once the controller has been calibrated. It takes a few seconds with the controller lying on a flat surface.
steamify.onboard.gyro.none: This controller has no gyro, so there's nothing to calibrate
steamify.option.haptics.master.tooltip: Scales every haptic effect at once. The individual sliders below set each effect relative to this
steamify.onboard.page3: Try the right stick, the right trackpad, and the gyro while your thumb rests on the trackpad
steamify.onboard.page4: Which layouts should the on-screen keyboard switch between?
